shellCommands.command: cd /workspace && for f in app/UserProfile.tsx app/ProductList.tsx app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -rn "Route Handler" --include=*.md 01-app/01-getting-started/ | grep -i "server component\|don't\|not need\|unnecessary\|skip\|directly" | head -20; echo "=== SEARCH2 ==="; grep -rniA6 "fetch.*your own\|own route handler\|call.*route handler.*from" --include=*.md 01-app/ | head -60
ls 01-app/01-getting-started/ && echo "=== CACHING ===" && grep -n "Working with runtime APIs" -A40 01-app/01-getting-started/*caching*.md | head -80
grep -rn "x-forwarded-proto\|host')\|get('host'" --include=*.md . | head -20; echo "=== HEADERS SIG ==="; grep -n "await headers()" -B3 -A12 01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/headers.md | head -40

(timeout 90 node_modules/.bin/next dev -p 3111 > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 25; echo "--- curl ---"; curl -s --max-time 20 http://localhost:3111/ | grep -oE "Ada Lovelace|ada@example.com|Loading profile|Dashboard|Sample Product" | sort -u; echo "--- devlog ---"; tail -20 /tmp/dev.log
rm -rf app/api && echo "temp route removed" && find app -type f | sort && echo "=== git status ===" && git status --short
git diff tsconfig.json && echo "=== AGENTS.md (untracked, first 8 lines) ===" && head -8 AGENTS.md

python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='tsconfig.json'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('"lib": [
      "dom",
      "dom.iterable",
      "esnext"
    ]','"lib": ["dom", "dom.iterable", "esnext"]')
s=s.replace('"@/*": [
        "./*"
      ]','"@/*": ["./*"]')
s=s.replace('"include": [
    "next-env.d.ts",
    "**/*.ts",
    "**/*.tsx",
    ".next/types/**/*.ts",
    ".next/dev/types/**/*.ts"
  ]','"include": [
    "next-env.d.ts",
    "**/*.ts",
    "**/*.tsx",
    ".next/types/**/*.ts",
    ".next/dev/types/**/*.ts"
  ]')
s=s.replace('"exclude": [
    "node_modules"
  ]','"exclude": ["node_modules"]')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git diff tsconfig.json
node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit && echo "TYPECHECK OK" && git diff --stat && echo "=== final component ===" && cat app/page.tsx
